description: This file is a code-behind for an ASP.NET Web Forms page that manages a multiple-choice question (MCQ) exam interface. It handles loading questions from a database based on the selected course, displays questions and options, allows answer selection, tracks exam time, and submits scores to the database.

classes.name: OnlineExamSystem.MCQExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for MCQExam.aspx, managing quiz load, submission, and timing functionalities.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page initialization, loads questions from the database based on course session, sets up timer.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to their profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates total score, records it in the database, and redirects to the result page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by redirecting to the login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates exam timer display and checks for timeout.
